review_candidates.title: Data Platforms Software Engineer
review_candidates.description: Department: Tech - Software Engineering Location: Oxford, UK Description Aurora helps governments, investors, and utilities make billion‑dollar decisions on the journey to net‑zero. Based in Oxford, you will work in a dynamic and growing engineering organisation that builds cloud-based software to track and model power grids around the world. Aurora's models produce some of the most data-intensive outputs in the energy industry – half hourly, generator-level simulations across 30-year horizons. As a founding Software Engineer on the Data Platforms team, you will build and own the infrastructure that makes that data fast, reliable, and useful. You will work in a small, fast-paced team that releases changes multiple times a day. The successful applicant will be an excellent problem solver, a strong team player, and a proven ability to take big projects from conception to production. We're open to a range of candidates - the role and compensation will reflect your experience. Key Responsibilities Build high-uptime platforms that serve 100TB -1PB data fast and reliably Build tools and platforms that empower engineers, modellers, and analysts across Aurora Be a founding member of the Data Platforms team - shaping its culture, practices, and technical direction from the ground up Skills, Knowledge and Expertise Required attributes: 3+ years developing impactful, mission-critical backend systems The ability to work in fast-paced, high-ownership environments Excellence in one or more language (we mostly use Python) Strong discipline in testing and automation Experienced, judicious user of AI coding tools An exceptional team player - low-ego, high-initiative Genuine interest in the transformation of energy markets and infrastructure Desirable attributes: Hands-on experience with large distributed systems Previous experience building data platform - including scheduling, streaming, storage, compute Python, Lakehouse architectures, Terraform, AWS What we offer Some of the benefits we include are: Private Medical Insurance Dental Insurance Parental Support Salary-Exchange Pension Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) Local Oxford Discounts Cycle-to-work Scheme Flu Jabs At AER, we are committed to offering flexibility in the way we work. Most of our roles are hybrid with a mix of in-office/home working and potentially adjustable working hours. Let’s discuss what works for you and AER during the interview process. The Company is committed to the principle that no employee or job applicant shall receive unfavourable treatment on grounds of age, disability, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, marriage or civil partnership, pregnancy, and maternity. To apply, please submit your Résumé / CV, a personal summary, your salary expectations and please inform us of your notice period. Unfortunately, we are unable to accept applications via email, telephone, or social media platforms. To be considered for this position, please submit your application using the link provided. Applications submitted through any other channel will not be reviewed.

review_candidates.description: Company Description: VMO, a proud member of the ALTEN Group, is part of a global engineering and IT services organization with over 60,000 employees worldwide. The company partners with major global enterprises, including leading Fortune 500 companies, to drive innovation and digital transformation. VMO’s expertise spans consulting, technology, and research, with strong capabilities in AI, Data, IoT, and Cloud. The company delivers technology solutions across multiple industries such as healthcare, finance, and manufacturing, helping organizations remain competitive in a rapidly evolving digital era. With a solid global presence and involvement in large-scale international projects, VMO continues to pioneer smart technology innovations. Join a night-shift team supporting an international enterprise client, owning both frontend and backend code quality with high autonomy and minimal real-time supervision Working Hours: Night shift: 21:00–05:00 or 22:00–06:00, Monday to Friday (GMT+7). Core Development & Architecture: Take full ownership of feature implementation, code quality, and refactoring across web applications and integrated backend microservices Lead architectural discussions, enforce design patterns, and ensure compliance with security and performance benchmarks Design and implement RESTful APIs and gRPC services, ensuring proper async handling and caching strategies on the frontend High-Autonomy Asynchronous Execution: Proactively unblock technical challenges without real-time daytime supervision Conduct structured, transparent daily handover reports with daytime technical leads Client Collaboration: Act as the direct engineering touchpoint for international client stakeholders during their daytime hours Clarify user stories, review pull requests, and demo completed outputs in clear English Requirement: Full stack Frontend: TypeScript , Modern JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3/PostCSS Remix/React , VueJS State & Styling: React Hooks, Context/Zustand, TailwindCSS/CSS Modules RESTful APIs, Fetch API, WebSocket; async rendering and caching handling Full stack Backend: TypeScript (Strict Mode) , SQL (Postgres dialect) / Java Node.js (v18+ LTS) , gRPC framework, REST APIs PostgreSQL on AWS RDS Drizzle ORM Tooling: LocalStack, Telepresence, Podman, Insomnia (gRPC client), kubectl Required: 4+ years (Middle) to 7.5+ years (Lead) of intensive software engineering experience Solid understanding of Git workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud environments (AWS/GCP) Strong proficiency in RESTful APIs, gRPC, GraphQL, and microservices architecture Independent, fluent English (listening, speaking, reading, writing); able to work directly with overseas technical leads and product owners without an intermediary Experience working in a dedicated model with enterprise clients Preferred: Experience with distributed systems, service mesh, or high-load microservices environments Familiarity with local development tooling for microservices (Telepresence, Podman/Docker, LocalStack) Experience mentoring or leading a small engineering team

review_candidates.title: Senior Frontend Developer
review_candidates.description: Company: SAQAYA Location: Egypt (Remote/Hybrid) 🚀 About SAQAYA SAQAYA is a fast-growing, global tech company with operations in the UK, Spain, and Egypt. We specialize in connecting top-tier engineering talent with world-class UK clients, delivering state-of-the-art solutions in the shipping and data analytics industry. Our team thrives on innovation, collaboration, and the pursuit of technical excellence. If you're passionate about quality, eager to make a tangible impact, and ready to work with a forward-thinking team, you’ll feel right at home here. Senior Frontend Developer 🚀 We’re looking for a Senior Frontend Developer to help build a reliable teacher editor, an accessible student portal, and an extensible admin console. You’ll play a key role in shaping the frontend architecture, introducing scalable design and testing systems, and creating experiences that are both powerful and accessible. 🛠️ What you’ll do Develop the teacher activity editor , working with complex state management and multi-step workflows. Build an interactive student portal focused on usability, performance and accessibility. Develop and extend an admin console using Material UI . Introduce comprehensive component and end-to-end testing from the ground up. Replace custom CSS patterns with a scalable, token-based design system . Establish frontend standards and reusable patterns that can evolve with the platform. Work closely with product, design and backend teams to turn complex requirements into intuitive user experiences. 🎯 What we’re looking for 4+ years of professional experience with React and TypeScript . Experience building complex, form-heavy editors with optimistic updates and robust error recovery. Strong understanding and practical application of WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility standards . Solid knowledge of Vite and modern frontend tooling . Strong native CSS skills and understanding of scalable styling approaches. Experience with component testing and end-to-end testing . Good understanding of frontend architecture, state management and reusable component design. Strong communication and problem-solving skills. 🌟 Nice to have Experience working with eLearning platforms . Experience building educational tools, content editors or complex SaaS applications. Experience establishing design systems or frontend platforms from scratch . Familiarity with Material UI . Why Join Saqaya? 🚀 We're building more than another software services company. We're building an AI-native product engineering business with global ambitions — combining strong engineering capabilities, an international customer base and an ambitious growth strategy. If you're the kind of salesperson who wants to build something rather than inherit it , this could be your opportunity. If you know how to turn cold accounts into conversations, conversations into opportunities, and opportunities into revenue — we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and let's talk.
